Entry.JapaneseText: いまはブレイナーとか言うの 探すんだべ？ 臆病風にでも吹かれたか、あーん？
Entry.EnglishText: We were lookin' for that "Brynhildr" fella, weren't we? Or what, are ya scared? Is yer spine turnin' to jelly, or something? Huh?

Entry.JapaneseText: おぉ、おめぇたち、よくぞここまで 勲章を集めただな、ご苦労ご苦労。 ノルン様からご褒美があるだで、 エトスハウスの 例の部屋に行ってみるだーよ
Entry.EnglishText: Well, would ya look at that. You've done some real fine work, gatherin' up this many medals. Well done. Well, Lady Norn should have a reward for ya, so try headin' on over to Ethos's House—to *that* room.

Entry.JapaneseText: おーい、はやる気持ちもわかるけんど、 ちゃんと準備できてっか！？ ヴァルハラとかのショップの売り物も 新しくなっているみたいだーよ。 この時代でちょっと寄り道して 準備万端にするのもありだべ
Entry.EnglishText: Oi... I know yer eager to get to it as fast as ya can, but are ya sure you're ready!? I hear they've got new stock up in Valhalla. It might do ya well to spend a little longer 'round this era, and see what you can put together, like.

Entry.JapaneseText: こ、こんどの時空戦士たちは バッチリ準備して駆けつけてくれたみたいだなや～ 前とはまるで強さが違うみてぇだから、 一度確認しておくとええだ
Entry.EnglishText: O-Oh... Seems like the Heroes of Time have prepared themselves real well before headin' over, this time~ They should be a good deal stronger than they were before, so you might want to check 'em out.

Entry.JapaneseText: ここにいるのは危険だーよ とっととズラかるだ！
Entry.EnglishText: It's too dangerous to go hangin' around here. Let's skedaddle!

Entry.JapaneseText: これが記憶陣だべ。 旅の記録ができるのはもちろん、 ダンジョンでは魔物も入ってこれないから、 おらも出てきてやるから着替えられるだ～よ。 ちなみに青い記憶陣は ＨＰも回復するだ。 おらの耳寄り情報に感謝せぇ～よ
Entry.EnglishText: This's a Memory Glyph. Ya can record your journey here, of course—but on top of that, monsters won't set foot on it, so I'll feel safe enough to help ya change your clothes~ Oh, and the blue ones will top up your HP, too. How's that? Aren't ya grateful for all my knowledge~?

Entry.JapaneseText: そんなに…… お金…… 持って無いだ……
Entry.EnglishText: Well, we, uh... haven't really got... that much money...

Entry.JapaneseText: なーんも反応しないべな…… やっぱりここも着替えが必要なんだべか？ とっとと調べろこのボケナス
Entry.EnglishText: It doesn't seem to be reactin' at all... Ya might need to change costumes, after all? Try and take a look around, ya birdbrain.

Entry.JapaneseText: みんなと別れただ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ya parted ways with everyone!

Entry.JapaneseText: むお？反応しないべ…… ほったら先に進むしかねぇべな
Entry.EnglishText: Hnn? Not gettin' any reaction... We might have to just keep going.

Entry.JapaneseText: アイテムが足りないだよ～
Entry.EnglishText: Ya don't have the right items~

Entry.JapaneseText: エネルギー切れで うまく作動できないようだべな……
Entry.EnglishText: It's out of power, so it's not runnin' properly....

Entry.JapaneseText: エレメンツポットと 今まで集めた精霊晶核を 失っただ……
Entry.EnglishText: Ya lost the Elemental Pot, and all the Atomic Cores we'd gathered, too...

Entry.JapaneseText: カギがかかってて開かないだな～ そのうち開くときがあるかもしんね。 気長に待つだーよ
Entry.EnglishText: Someone's put a lock on it, so it won't open~ But it might open up soon enough. Just be patient, like.

Entry.JapaneseText: カギがついてて開かないだ こういうのは中身が気になるべ～
Entry.EnglishText: Someone's put a lock on it, so it won't open. Always makes me want to see what it is they've got in there~

Entry.JapaneseText: システム 『オーバーブレイブ』と 『オーバーキル』が開放されただ！
Entry.EnglishText: Ya unlocked the "Overbrave" and "Overkill" systems!

Entry.JapaneseText: ハゲぼうずたちだけで戦ったから ショートカットの設定が外れちまっただ…… 戦う前には注意するべや～
Entry.EnglishText: Ya battled with just the numbskull's little group, so your shortcuts were all unset... Might check into that before the next fight~

Entry.JapaneseText: フリーパーティーシステムが開放されただ！ 今後は戦闘参加人数を２～４人の間で自由に 決めることができるでな。 詳しくはバトルメモに書いてあっから よっく確認するだよ～
Entry.EnglishText: Ya unlocked the Free Party System! From here on, ya can form any party ya like, long as it's got 2-4 members. If you've got any questions, read up on it in the Battle Book~
